title: org.ligatureprotocol.group
description: DRAFT. A group's membership document: its group key, members by master key with roles, the devices the group owns by principal key, and policy. Signed by the group key and gossiped among members' devices and group-owned devices; a higher version replaces a lower; there is no group repository (spec chapter 10). The domain ligatureprotocol.org is a placeholder; it is not yet registered.

publicKey.description: A public key as a multibase string with a multicodec prefix (an Ed25519 key renders as z6Mk…).

typeName.description: A reverse-DNS type name such as org.ligatureprotocol.capability.clipboard.

person.description: The member's master key. Members must already be known persons to the admins.

acceptance.description: Signature by the member's user-signing key over their acceptance (spec chapter 01).

expiresAt.description: For guests: when the membership ends.

policy.description: What members may do with the group's shared devices when nobody is present. Anything not listed is denied.

unattendedAllow.description: Capability types any member may use on a shared device when no one is present.

promptTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a present person has to answer before a request is treated as denied.

ownedDevice.description: A device the group owns: no user accounts, owner set is the group key.

key.description: The device's principal key, which members' devices trust because this document lists it.

memberAllow.description: Capability types members may use on this device. Overrides the group-wide unattendedAllow for this device.

groupKey.description: The group's identity. Held by every admin.

version.description: Increases with every change. A device keeps only the highest version it has verified.

ownedDevices.description: Devices the group owns (spec chapter 10 section 5).

signature.description: Signature by the group key over the document without this field.
